name: Publish/Subscribe Protocols

evidence.rationale: Default-deny policies can block MQTT and other publish/subscribe services unless they are explicitly required. An approved publish/subscribe service could still be misused.

Filter publish/subscribe protocol traffic crossing segment boundaries to approved brokers, destinations, and expected ports, reducing use of untrusted resources or irregular ports for command and control.
Network intrusion prevention solutions can use signatures for malicious publish/subscribe protocol traffic associated with specific adversary tools to block activity at monitored network boundaries.
Application-aware filtering can restrict publish/subscribe protocols to approved brokers, destinations, and expected service ports.
